# 🧰 Project Templates

Templates are evidence-based starting points. Replace placeholders, remove inapplicable sections with a reason, and never leave fictional test results or approvals.

## Decisions and design
- [ADR](adr.md), [architecture review](architecture-review.md), [feature proposal](feature-proposal.md), [game rule change](game-rule-change.md), [design review](design-review.md), [change request](change-request-template.md), [code review](code-review-template.md).

## API, data and engineering
- [API documentation](api-documentation-template.md), [database schema](database-schema-template.md), [dependency update](dependency-update.md), [migration](migration-template.md).

## Quality, risk and security
- [Bug report](bug-report.md), [QA test case](qa-test-case-template.md), [test plan](test-plan.md), [test report](test-report-template.md), [risk register](risk-register.md), [risk assessment](risk-assessment-template.md), [security review](security-review.md), [security audit](security-audit-template.md), [accessibility review](accessibility-review.md), [gameplay playtest](gameplay-playtest.md), [content review](content-review.md).

## Operations and project management
- [Incident report](incident-report.md), [release notes](release-notes.md), [release checklist](release-checklist.md), [deployment checklist](deployment-checklist.md), [rollback checklist](rollback-checklist.md), [maintenance checklist](maintenance-checklist.md), [project status](project-status-template.md), [meeting notes](meeting-notes-template.md), [pull request](pull-request.md).

Use API/database templates only when those systems genuinely exist. The current game has no live API or persisted database.
